basis: Repository MIT LICENSE and owner-confirmed code license; dependencies keep their own licenses. File-level sidecar preserves frozen producer bytes.
scope: Git-tracked first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript sources, including snapshots; excludes installed dependencies.
hash_policy: sha256 records original local bytes; sha256_lf normalizes CRLF to LF for Git checkout portability. This license inventory is separate from the frozen experiment producer hashes.
